additions.text: Second piece: the verb. Person + verb + something else = your first sentence: yo + soy + Alex.
You now have the three pieces: person + verb + something else. Now you choose the verb: ser for who the person is, estar for how or where the person is.
Yo + soy + de Australia. Ella + está + en casa. Change one piece and you have a new sentence.
